setup_cmd: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y gettext librsvg2-bin protobuf-compiler device-tree-compiler swig libglib2.0-dev libgtk-3-dev && curl -LsSf https://github.com/coredevices/PebbleOS-SDK/releases/download/v$(cat SDK_VERSION)/pebbleos-sdk-installer.sh | sh -s -- --version $(cat SDK_VERSION) --defaults && pip install -U pip && pip install -r requirements.txt
